articles.title: La Federación ceutí muestra "tristeza, rechazo y decepción" por no acoger partido de España sub 20
articles.standfirst: Ha emitido un comunicado tras la confirmación de Louzán este domingo de que el amistoso ante México no se celebraría en la localidad
articles.summary: Ha emitido un comunicado tras la confirmación de Louzán este domingo de que el amistoso ante México no se celebraría en la localidad
articles.body: La Real Federación de Fútbol de Ceuta ha expresado hoy su "profunda tristeza, decepción y rechazo" tras confirmarse que el partido amistoso entre las selecciones sub-20 de España y México del 30 de septiembre no se jugará finalmente en Ceuta porque "lo desaconseja" la Policía Nacional El pronunciamiento, en un comunicado de la Federación Ceutí, se ha producido después de que este domingo el presidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol, Rafael Louzán, confirmara en Málaga que no se celebraría este encuentro en Ceuta debido a la situación que vive esta ciudad y después de que el Ministerio del Interior desaconsejara su celebración, al considerar que no podían garantizarse las condiciones necesarias para el dispositivo policial. La federación ceutí (FFCE) ha expresado que la decisión del Gobierno de España, a través del Ministerio dirigido por Fernando Grande-Marlaska, "impide que culmine el trabajo desarrollado en los últimos días por la FFCE, la RFEF, la Ciudad Autónoma de Ceuta y la AD Ceuta FC para hacer posible este encuentro". "La noticia supone un nuevo golpe para una ciudad que lleva semanas soportando una situación excepcional y de ver alterado el uso normal de sus playas y espacios públicos", ha señalado. La Federación ceutí, que preside Antonio García Gaona, ha considerado que la llegada de una selección española "suponía mucho más que un partido de fútbol ya que representaba una oportunidad para devolver ilusión a miles de ceutíes y ofrecer una imagen de normalidad que la ciudad necesita recuperar cuanto antes". La Federación de Ceuta ha estimado que "resulta especialmente difícil de entender la posición del Ministerio del Interior, ya que hace apenas unos días Fernando Grande-Marlaska calificaba como subjetiva la sensación de inseguridad existente en Ceuta y ahora el departamento que dirige utiliza la presión migratoria, la tensión social y la falta de medios suficientes como argumentos para desaconsejar la celebración del encuentro". Para el estamento federativo ceutí, "ambas posiciones resultan difícilmente conciliables, ya que si Ceuta se encuentra en una situación de normalidad y seguridad, cuesta explicar esta decisión y si son necesarios más recursos y efectivos, la respuesta del Gobierno de España debe ser aportarlos y garantizar el desarrollo normal de la actividad de la ciudad, no limitar sus oportunidades". "Además, Ceuta ya ha demostrado su capacidad para albergar encuentros deportivos de primer nivel, además de que la AD Ceuta FC compite en LaLiga Hypermotion y disputa con normalidad sus partidos como local en el estadio Alfonso Murube, con los dispositivos de seguridad propios del fútbol profesional", ha recordado. La Federación de Ceuta dice que "resulta difícil justificar que Ceuta pueda acoger regularmente encuentros de la segunda categoría del fútbol español y, al mismo tiempo, no pueda celebrar un amistoso internacional de categoría sub-20, por lo que Ceuta no puede seguir pagando las consecuencias de la falta de medios de otras administraciones sino que la ciudad necesita soluciones, recursos y normalidad". "Hoy pierde el fútbol ceutí pero, sobre todo, pierde una ciudad que necesitaba una alegría", ha añadido la Federación que insiste en que seguirá trabajando para que "en un futuro no muy lejano, Ceuta pueda recibir el encuentro internacional que merece y disfrutar de una Selección Española jugando en nuestra tierra".

articles.title: El Atlético de Madrid se corona campeón de la Madrid Football Cup U-14
articles.standfirst: El conjunto rojiblanco se impuso en la final al Rayo Vallecano por 2-0 en la XI edición de un torneo que ha contado con un cartel histórico
articles.summary: El conjunto rojiblanco se impuso en la final al Rayo Vallecano por 2-0 en la XI edición de un torneo que ha contado con un cartel histórico
articles.body: La edición 2026 ha vuelto a reunir un cartel de primer nivel mundial: 32 equipos procedentes de 18 países, con 16 equipos profesionales de primera o segunda división de sus respectivos países, 7 participantes en la UEFA Champions League 2026-27 y 5 campeones de las ligas más importantes de Europa. A estos se suman tres academias internacionales oficiales de clubes de primera división -Atlético de Madrid Academy Kazakhstan, Inter Academy Georgia y Villarreal Houston Academy-, que representan el creciente esfuerzo de los grandes clubes europeos por expandir su metodología a nuevos mercados de alto potencial futbolístico. El torneo contó con la participación de 10 equipos debutantes, entre los que destacan el Tottenham Hotspur y el Newcastle United, dos de los grandes nombres de la Premier League inglesa. La representación internacional fue especialmente notable, con 4 equipos de Inglaterra, 3 de Suecia, 3 de Noruega, 3 de Norteamérica y una sólida presencia de Europa del Este, con clubes de Eslovaquia, Rumanía, Bielorrusia y Georgia. El partido inaugural del torneo ya dejó una de las imágenes más emotivas de la competición: el Real Madrid remontó un 1-0 adverso para vencer 1-2 al Spartak Trnava de Eslovaquia en un encuentro que marcó el tono de intensidad y nivel que definiría toda la competición. Los cuartos de final reunieron a cuatro clubes madrileños -Atlético de Madrid, Rayo Vallecano, Leganés y Real Madrid- y a cuatro equipos internacionales -FC Porto, Academia Hagi, Next Level Soccer y Atlético de Madrid Academy Kazakhstan-, una mezcla que refleja perfectamente el equilibrio entre talento local e internacional que caracteriza a esta competición. La gran sorpresa del torneo la protagonizó la Academia Hagi de Rumanía, que confirmó ser un proyecto formativo de primer nivel con jugadores de una calidad muy destacada. El conjunto rumano se alzó con el tercer puesto tras vencer en la tanda de penaltis al bicampeón FC Porto en el partido por el tercer y cuarto puesto, una victoria que resume la magnitud de lo que está construyendo el proyecto del exinternacional Gheorghe Hagi en el sureste de Europa. En la gran final, el Atlético de Madrid demostró por qué es el club más regular de la historia de la MFC U-14. Los rojiblancos dominaron al Rayo Vallecano con contundencia y se impusieron 2-0, conquistando su segundo título en el torneo tras el de 2022 y consolidándose como el club más laureado de la competición. Un año más, la Madrid Football Cup U-14 ha demostrado ser mucho más que un torneo. La competición, que desde su primera edición ha apostado por reunir el mejor fútbol base internacional en Alcobendas, ha vuelto a ser el escenario en el que los mejores jóvenes talentos del mundo han medido su nivel ante los ojos del fútbol profesional. Musiala, Foden, Zaïre-Emery, Barcola, Cubarsí o Bergvall son solo algunos de los nombres que pasaron por estos mismos campos antes de convertirse en referentes del fútbol mundial.

articles.title: Suiza pierde a su capitán Xhaka: investigado por falsificar un certificado de vacunas de Covid-19
articles.standfirst: La fiscalía de Lucerna está llevando a cabo una investigación sobre el capitán suizo del Sunderland, que no ha sido convocado para disputar los partidos de la Nations League
articles.summary: La fiscalía de Lucerna está llevando a cabo una investigación sobre el capitán suizo del Sunderland, que no ha sido convocado para disputar los partidos de la Nations League
articles.body: Granit Xhaka afronta un grave problema lejos de los terrenos de juego. El centrocampista del Sunderland está siendo investigado por el Ministerio Público de Lucerna por su presunta relación con un certificado de vacunación contra el Covid-19 que habría sido obtenido de forma fraudulenta. El futbolista, que se ha quedado fuera de la lista de Suiza para los partidos de la UEFA Nations League, deberá declarar ante las autoridades suizas a comienzos de octubre. La investigación trata de determinar si Xhaka obtuvo un certificado sin haberse vacunado y si pudo cometerse un delito relacionado con la falsificación de documentos. En el procedimiento también está implicada una médica de Lucerna, cuya consulta fue registrada por la policía en 2023. Las autoridades encontraron documentación relacionada con varios certificados. Según la legislación suiza, la falsificación de documentos puede acarrear una pena de hasta cinco años de prisión, aunque la posible condena dependería de las circunstancias concretas del caso. Xhaka, por el momento, mantiene la presunción de inocencia y la investigación continúa abierta. Tras el partido ante el Manchester City, el internacional suizo fue preguntado por el procedimiento y evitó entrar en detalles: "No tengo ningún comentario que hacer al respecto. Hoy he jugado al fútbol y eso es lo que me importa". Cuando le preguntaron si estaba preocupado por el caso, fue contundente: "En absoluto. Ya he pasado por cosas peores".

articles.title: Este Sevilla recuerda a otros tiempos
articles.standfirst: Tras la séptima jornada, los hispalenses se van al parón en quinta posición, firmando su mejor arranque desde la era Lopetegui
articles.summary: Tras la séptima jornada, los hispalenses se van al parón en quinta posición, firmando su mejor arranque desde la era Lopetegui
articles.body: El Sevilla se marcha al primer parón internacional de la temporada asentado en la zona noble de LaLiga. Una vez que se han disputado las primeras siete jornadas del campeonato, el cuadro hispalense ocupa la quinta posición de la tabla con 13 puntos de 21 posibles, fruto de un balance de cuatro victorias, un empate y dos derrotas. Este sorprendente registro le permite mantener un colchón interesante para afrontar el resto del curso con serenidad. Hasta la fecha, solamente los dos primeros clasificados de LaLiga, el Barcelona y el Atlético de Madrid, han sido capaces de vencer al Sevilla. A pesar de que tanto culés como colchoneros se llevaron el triunfo del Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán, los locales supieron competir en ambos duelos, dejando al final una buena imagen. Por el momento, mantienen una brecha de ocho puntos sobre los puestos de descenso, así como tres de diferencia respecto a los perseguidores que están fuera de las plazas europeas. Las sensaciones que transmite este Sevilla de Luis García Plaza son las de un equipo con un poso competitivo y una solidez que recuerda a épocas más gloriosas. Para encontrar un arranque similar hay que remontarse a la campaña 2021-2022 con Julen Lopetegui en el banquillo, cuando los de Nervión eran terceros con 15 puntos. En los últimos cuatro años no superaban la barrera de los 10 puntos a estas alturas de campeonato, ya que casi siempre coqueteaban con la zona de descenso. Un cambio de dinámica que como poco tranquiliza al sevillismo. Este receso internacional servirá como una minipretemporada para recuperar efectivos importantes en el Sevilla, como Kike Salas y Lucas Stassin. El calendario no concederá tregua tras el parón. A los hispalenses les espera un mes de octubre cargado de compromisos y en el que tendrán dos salidas muy complicadas: visitarán al Levante el 12 de octubre y al Real Madrid el 18, antes de volver a Nervión para recibir a Osasuna justo a la semana siguiente. Durante estos 20 días, el equipo podrá mantener el ritmo competitivo con la XV Edición del Trofeo Antonio Puerta, que lo enfrentará al Aston Villa el próximo 2 de octubre.

articles.title: Raphinha and Mo Salah hat-tricks, Harry Kane landmark, Ruben Amorim finally adapts plus more in the Euro Debrief
articles.summary: Jose Mourinho frustrated, more goals for Harry Kane and big wins for Ruben Amorim and Liam Rosenior. Adam Bate picks out the big stories from the continent in the Euro Debrief, a Sky Sports column focusing on the major European leagues and more...
articles.body:
Welcome to The Euro Debrief , a new Sky Sports column in which Adam Bate rounds up some of the key stories from the latest matches across the continent. This week:

Raphinha has been busy backing Lamine Yamal to win the Ballon d'Or but it is tough to explain the Brazilian forward taking second billing to anyone right now. After scoring a hat-trick in midweek, he followed up with another in Barcelona's 3-1 win at Sevilla.

This was a perfect hat-trick - right foot, header, left foot - and further underlined the fact that Raphinha is far from out of position up front. At 29, this is a player belatedly finding his true calling. The variety of his goals proves that Raphinha can now do it all.

Barca are in irresistible form and are already five points clear of second and six ahead of Real Madrid after Jose Mourinho's side lost the derby to Atletico on Sunday. After an unusually subdued return to life in LaLiga, we are now getting the full Mourinho.

The criticism of the appointed referee began in a veiled way beforehand and was rather more obvious after the 2-1 defeat. Mourinho accused Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias of not handling the pressure and even brought printouts to the press conference.

He talked of "two clear red cards" and those familiar with Cristian Romero's career will perhaps feel that he had a point regarding the Atletico defender's follow-through on Jude Bellingham, although the stills of that looked rather worse than the real-time replays.

"The ones who should be really happy are the referee appointment committee because everything was very strange," Mourinho went on to complain. "They assign a referee who at 41 has never been an international referee so it's clearly not because he's a great referee."

The dark hints at conspiracies against his team are nothing new with Mourinho. But they cannot mask the evidence of a gulf to Barcelona that shows little sign of closing. As against Betis, when faced with quality opposition Real Madrid have been found wanting.

In the other games, Celta were big winners, putting five past Racing. But there is still no joy for Valencia after sacking Carlos Corberan. The final goal of the weekend in LaLiga was a vicious hit by La Real's Ander Barrenetxea to stun Mestalla in stoppage time.

LaLiga results: Espanyol 1-3 Elche, Osasuna 1-1 Rayo Vallecano, Athletic Club 0-0 Alaves, Celta Vigo 5-0 Racing Santander, Sevilla 1-3 Barcelona, Getafe 1-0 Malaga, Atletico Madrid 2-1 Real Madrid, Deportivo A Coruna 1-1 Real Betis, Villarreal 3-1 Levante, Valencia 2-3 Real Sociedad.

Harry Kane reached another milestone in Bayern Munich's seven-goal rout of Union Berlin. The England captain hit the century mark with the first of his two goals in what was only his 98th Bundesliga appearance. Nobody has made it to three figures so fast.

As has so often been the case during Kane's time at Bayern, the best player on the pitch was actually Michael Olise. He scored three and set up Kane's second in another classy outing. Kane is tipped for the Ballon d'Or but his team-mate surely cannot be far behind.

Elsewhere, there was yet more woe for Borussia Monchengladbach as they came out on the wrong side of a seven-goal thriller against Mainz. Augsburg were beaten for the first time at Werder Bremen and Freiburg lost their 100 per cent record at Eintracht Frankfurt.

That means the only team yet to drop a point in the Bundesliga are Borussia Dortmund. Maxi Beier scored the winner away to Stuttgart with substitute Jobe Bellingham helping to make the difference by providing the assist for what was the only goal of the game.

It was a difficult day for the Dortmund coach Niko Kovac, who was told on air after the game about the passing of Peter Hermann, his former assistant manager at Bayern, aged 74. Fighting back tears during the interview, it was impossible not to feel for him.

But what a job he is doing. There are clear signs of progress at Dortmund. They have won all six of their matches in all competitions and have more clean sheets than Bayern Munich in the Bundesliga since the summer of 2025. Stay solid and they have a chance.

Bundesliga results: Bayern Munich 7-0 Union Berlin, Borussia Monchengladbach 3-4 Mainz, Eintracht Frankfurt 2-2 Freiburg, Hamburg 2-1 Cologne, Werder Bremen 3-2 Augsburg, Stuttgart 0-1 Borussia Dortmund, Bayer Leverkusen 2-0 RB Leipzig, Schalke 0-0 Elversberg, Paderborn 3-1 Hoffenheim.

Inter showed their remarkable powers of recovery yet again as they came from two goals behind against Roma to earn a point that preserves their unbeaten record. The Italian champions have now conceded the first two goals in their last four matches.

They had actually won the previous two of them in Serie A. Here, that man Lautaro Martinez scored twice to prevent Roma staying perfect. Mark of champions? Perhaps. But the signs are that it could be an exciting title race in Italy with four teams still undefeated.

Among them are AC Milan as Ruben Amorim bounced back from defeat in Europe by doing what he was never willing to do at Manchester United and tweaking his formation. Milan operated with a back four in the build-up against Lecce and won the game 3-0.

The shift was not so seismic, a fluid formation that saw Mario Gila move to right-back, giving Samuel Chukwueze more freedom to attack ahead of him, but it was enough for Amorim to note the change. "I cannot make the same mistakes," he admitted.

"What I felt in the last games is the same that I felt at Manchester United," Amorim explained afterwards. "Sometimes we do not have the perfect characteristics to play in that way and if we do not have it then we have to adapt." An epiphany. Better late than never.

Elsewhere, Billy Gilmour scored for Napoli and a word too for another British player enjoying himself in Italy. Harry Winks suffered back-to-back relegations with Leicester but has started every game for Cagliari this season as they made it four wins from five.

Serie A results: Monza 2-1 Sassuolo, Bologna 1-1 Torino, Udinese 0-1 Cagliari, Roma 2-2 Inter, Venezia 0-2 Lazio, Fiorentina 1-1 Napoli, Frosinone 2-0 Como, Parma 2-1 Genoa, Juventus 2-0 Atalanta, Milan 3-0 Lecce.

It took until the ninth and final game of the weekend in Ligue 1 for the run of home victories to come to an end as Paris Saint-Germain went to the Velodrome and beat rivals Marseille 2-1 in the big one on Sunday. Marquinhos scored the winner for PSG.

Although this was a spirited effort, it is four defeats in five games now for Marseille, their worst start to a Ligue 1 season. PSG remain oddly wasteful - they missed seven big chances in this game - but a third win in a row hints at the European champions finding form.

Nevertheless, the top team in the capital right now is managed by Liam Rosenior not Luis Enrique. The English coach certainly savoured Paris FC's 2-1 win over his former club Strasbourg, pointedly celebrating in front of the visiting fans and sparking ugly scenes.

"A small part of the supporters, and I emphasise, a small part of them, because Strasbourg is a fantastic club, were disrespectful," Rosenior explained afterwards. "They insulted my family. So for me, celebrating like that, obviously it was a message."

Rosenior's side remain unbeaten, with the best defensive record in France in terms of goals conceded and expected goals conceded. It is Monaco that go into the break on top, though, and there was a first win of the campaign for Nice against Lille.

Ligue 1 results: Monaco 2-1 Lens, Paris FC 2-1 Strasbourg, Angers 2-0 Troyes, Le Mans 2-1 Lorient, Lyon 4-0 Rennes, Toulouse 3-2 Le Havre, Auxerre 2-1 Brest, Nice 2-1 Lille, Marseille 1-2 Paris Saint-Germain.

Mohamed Salah scored a hat-trick for Trabzonspor against Galatasaray in a sensational result on Saturday. It was a first defeat of the league season for the reigning champions and came in emphatic fashion as Salah inspired a 4-0 win - getting an assist too.

The most striking thing was Salah's sharpness, racing through from his own half for the first and last goals of the game. In between, Davinson Sanchez's error gifted him the other as Salah outshone Rafael Leao. He now has seven goals in six league games.

The team topping the Super Lig, however, is newly promoted Amedspor. To say the side with strong ties to the Kurdish population is causing a stir would be an understatement. Gift Orban's monster hit from distance set them on the path to a 3-2 win over Besiktas.

On Sunday evening, it was an enjoyable experience to attend O Classico as Porto defeated Benfica 3-1 at the Estadio do Dragao. Marco Silva has undoubtedly improved Benfica and they played some good football before Clement Lenglet was sent off.

But Porto punished them, despite Silva's side briefly pulling level with 10 men. The win means that the title holders have seven wins from seven games now and already boast a five-point lead at the top of the table in Portugal. Francesco Farioli delivering again.

articles.title: El Badajoz demanda a la FIFA por una suspensión que, según el club, le costó el ascenso directo
articles.standfirst: El conflicto viene por impedir al club inscribir jugadores al inicio de la temporada 2025-26.
articles.summary: El conflicto viene por impedir al club inscribir jugadores al inicio de la temporada 2025-26.
articles.body: El CD Badajoz ha presentado una demanda en Florida contra la FIFA y César Chaparro Yedro, responsable del área de Registro de Jugadores de la FIFA en Miami, por la gestión de una suspensión que impidió al club inscribir jugadores al inicio de la temporada 2025-26. Según la demanda, el Badajoz recibió el 3 de septiembre de 2025 la petición de presentar nueve documentos para superar una evaluación de cumplimiento. El club asegura que entregó toda la documentación en menos de 24 horas y reclamó reiteradamente que se revisara antes de su primer partido, previsto para el 7 de septiembre. La FIFA, siempre según la versión del Badajoz, no levantó la suspensión a tiempo y el equipo perdió aquel encuentro por incomparecencia. La situación también afectó al fútbol base del club. El Badajoz sostiene que unos 400 jugadores de cantera quedaron afectados por el bloqueo, incluidos 335 menores de 15 años. La suspensión fue levantada provisionalmente el 11 de septiembre y de forma definitiva el día 15. El club reclama ahora daños económicos y reputacionales y sostiene que la gestión de la FIFA provocó, además, una sanción de tres puntos que resultó decisiva en la clasificación final. El Badajoz y el Don Benito terminaron la temporada con 71 puntos, pero el Don Benito logró el campeonato y el ascenso directo por el 'goal average' particular. El Badajoz sostiene que, sin la pérdida de esos tres puntos, habría acabado con 74 y habría sido campeón. Finalmente, el conjunto pacense consiguió ascender a Segunda Federación tras disputar el playoff. La demanda también cuestiona los vínculos familiares de Yedro con Don Benito. El club afirma que el responsable de la FIFA no reveló esas relaciones ni se apartó del expediente. El Badajoz cifra provisionalmente el daño reputacional en entre 4 y 8 millones de dólares, además de otros perjuicios económicos, entre ellos la pérdida de patrocinadores y los gastos derivados de disputar el playoff. La demanda sostiene que busca una compensación económica y no pretende modificar los resultados deportivos de la temporada.

articles.title: Who was Rijohn Jose? 29-year-old footballer dies in road accident in Kozhikode
articles.summary: Football News: Calicut FC footballer Rijohn Jose died in a road accident in Kozhikode late Sunday night, days before the start of the new Super League Kerala season..
articles.body: Calicut FC footballer Rijohn Jose died in a road accident in Kozhikode late Sunday night, days before the start of the new Super League Kerala season.The 29-year-old was travelling on a motorcycle with fellow footballer Ghani Ahmed Nigam when their vehicle collided with another motorcycle near Christian College on the Gandhi Road flyover at around 10.30 pm, news agency ANI reported.Both players were taken to Kozhikode Medical College Hospital after the accident. Rijohn died from his injuries at around 12.15 am IST. He was a native of Thrissur.Nigam, who also represents Kerala in the Santosh Trophy, suffered serious injuries and is undergoing treatment.The accident happened just hours after Calicut FC announced its squad for the upcoming Super League Kerala season. The team had also begun preparations for the tournament, which starts on September 25.Both Rijohn and Nigam had reached the city as part of the club's preparations.Rijohn had played as a defender for Forca Kochi in the previous edition of the Super League Kerala before returning to Calicut FC for the 2026 season.Gokulam Kerala FC condoles Rijohn's deathGokulam Kerala FC on Monday expressed condolences over Rijohn's death.In a post on Instagram, the club extended its support to Rijohn's family, teammates and Calicut FC."It is with deep sorrow that we mourn the passing of Rijohn Jose of Calicut FC. Our heartfelt condolences to his family, teammates, friends, and the entire Calicut FC family. May they find strength and comfort in this difficult time," the club wrote."You left too soon. We weren’t ready for a goodbye. We weren’t ready to lose you, Rijohn. Holding your family, friends, teammates and everyone dear to you close in our thoughts. Forever, our champion. Rest in peace, Rijohn," Calicut FC said in a post on Instagram.Who was Rijohn Jose?Born in September 1997 in Thrissur, Rijohn Jose was a familiar name in Kerala football and had represented several clubs in domestic football.He began his professional career with FC Deccan before playing for Wayanad United, Sreebhumi FC and George Telegraph SC.He later became a regular defender for Forca Kochi FC in the 2024 and 2025 editions of the Super League Kerala.Ahead of the 2026 season, Rijohn returned to Calicut FC, the club he had helped win the inaugural Super League Kerala title in 2024 after defeating Forca Kochi FC 2-1 in the final.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Manchester United: Running stats for Michael Carrick's side examined after intensity criticism in draw at Fulham
articles.summary: Man Utd drew 1-1 at Fulham on Sunday thanks to a late deflected Matheus Cunha shot; Michael Carrick's side were criticised for their intensity and stats show they rank bottom in the Premier League for high-speed runs this season and were out-run at Craven Cottage
articles.body:
Matheus Cunha gave a damning view from inside the squad, telling Sky Sports : "They put in more energy than us, we cannot accept this."

Sky Sports pundit Gary Neville said: "I've never seen a Man Utd team walk out of possession as much as that."

So what do the stats say about United's work-rate at Craven Cottage - and how big a problem is it for Michael Carrick?

Man Utd rank joint-bottom in the Premier League for high-speed runs, according to Opta.

They are level with Man City on 1691 high-speed runs - but their neighbours played with 10 men for the majority of the derby at Old Trafford, which needs to be factored into their figures.

Man Utd spent 52.98 per cent of their time out of possession at Fulham walking.

Seven teams have posted a higher figure this term, although it is the highest percentage Man Utd have recorded this season.

United's average for this campaign of 51.13 per cent ranks them 17 th in the Premier League.

Since the start of last season there have been 30 times a team has spent a greater percentage of time walking out of possession in a Premier League match than Man Utd did at Fulham.

That includes the 54.59 per cent United recorded in their 3-0 win at Brighton on the final day of last season.

Man Utd ran 110.2km on Sunday - the second-lowest total of the Premier League weekend, behind Liverpool's 108.4km figure at Bournemouth.

United ran 6.5km less than Fulham - the second biggest difference between teams this season when both keep 11 men on the pitch. (Arsenal out-ran Coventry by 6.8km on the opening night of the season).

Man Utd have also been out-run in terms of distance by Hull , Ipswich and Everton this season. Man City - who had Phil Foden sent off after 23 minutes - are the only side United have run further than in the Premier League this term.

Man Utd allowed Fulham to start their passing sequences, on average, 36.9m from the United goal. That is the nearest any team allowed their opponents to begin from, on average, in the Premier League this past weekend.

It reflects how United sat deep out of possession at Craven Cottage.

Fulham, by contrast, allowed United to start attacks 43.4m from their goal, on average - the third-highest figure of the latest round of matches.

In his post-match analysis, Neville referenced Fulham's amount of 10+ passing sequences.

Fulham had more 'build-up attacks' (10+ passing sequences that end in a shot or touch in the opposition box) than any other side this weekend.

It's worth pointing out United boss Carrick rejected the suggestion United had energy issues in the game when Cunha's quotes were put to him in his post-match press conference. "The way we finished the game it didn't look like that for me," he said.

Their 'progress' stat, measuring metres gained per passing sequence, was top for this latest round of Premier League games, showing how they were able to advance far up the pitch from their deep starting position when they won the ball back off Fulham.

In fact, their 36 penalty-box entries was the most of any team in any Premier League game this season.

United had 29 shots at Fulham - including two against the woodwork in the first half. That has contributed to their total of 113 shots this season, which is the most of any team.

They also have the third-best Expected Goals total in the Premier League of 10.24.

The problem for Carrick is those positive numbers around their attacking play are overshadowed by taking just five points from their first five games - at the beginning of a campaign where United fans had been excited about their team kicking on from their third-place finish last season.

Their frustrations around results and performances have then been further fuelled by low-ranking running stats.

A failure to beat bottom-of-the-table Tottenham after the international break would turn this into United's worst-ever start to a Premier League season and raise more hard-hitting questions about the output of Carrick's team.

articles.title: What do Arsenal stand for? Gunners risk falling behind those in the WSL title race if they do not sharpen up
articles.summary: Digital journalist Laura Hunter returns for a second season with a WSL-dedicated column, analysing all the big talking points from across the weekend's action; this week's focus is on Arsenal's failure to convert dominance into goals and a defining week for Spurs' Olivia Holdt
articles.body:
Arsenal cannot be also-rans already, can they?

Arsenal have set a club record for longest unbeaten streak in the Women's Super League (20 games). But that will be scant consolation for Renee Slegers after dropping two points at home to a Manchester United side who have shown untold vulnerabilities in the opening weeks of the season, shipping a league-high seven goals.

The Gunners do not lose at home under Slegers. So it stands to reason that Smilla Holmberg would latch onto a beautifully flighted cross from Leah Williamson to score a 95th-minute equaliser and preserve that honour. The goal was excellently worked.

But its quality was barely perceptible among an expectant Emirates crowd, some of whom will have travelled to Crystal Palace last weekend to watch a goalless stalemate play out, leaving both games with an odd sense of deja vu. Arsenal look to be blowing their chances of a proper title chase at the first hurdle. Again.

Five points from three games is only enough for sixth in this elevated, elongated league, now made up of 14 teams instead of 12. Perhaps that extension offers Slegers some solace. There will inevitably be a few more hiding places along the course of a 26-game season; this might even come to be known as a 'good point' when all is said and done.

Contextually, for now, it can only be framed as a setback. Another stick to bash with. More proof of Arsenal's inability to keep pace with whomever the best team is in the league on any given year. There has been little evidence to the contrary for the past seven seasons, despite finishing second last term.

And so what are Arsenal, if not title contenders? What do they stand for, if not playing an attractive style that pairs with results? Are they a side with only the threat of goals, who lack the conviction with which goals are scored? From 60 attempts so far, Arsenal have netted twice, an xG underperformance of 3.84.

Of course, Slegers has plenty of time for rebuttal to such critique. No team should be written off after three games, we are barely passed the break line. And yet, Arsenal's three outings have revealed an issue that extends well beyond that timeframe. A realisation that most opposition teams appear to have in their tactical back pocket.

Sit in a compact block against Arsenal and they will struggle to break you down. To stay disciplined against Arsenal is worthy of a point, very rarely more, but a draw is useful for nearly every team besides the Gunners themselves. Put the brakes on and take what is rightfully yours.

Four draws before Christmas was enough to effectively rule them out of the title running last year, they can ill-afford for that to happen again. Such an urge must be suppressed quickly. But how?

The speed and unpredictability with which Arsenal attack is waning. Mariona Caldentey blasts Alessia Russo's lay-off carelessly wide. Stina Blackstenius plants her point-blank header at but not beyond Phallon Tullis-Joyce. Chloe Kelly tries her luck from distance. All valid attempts, somehow laced with undermining doubt.

They saved their best moment until the very last kick.

Questions should be asked of both Slegers and her players after such a passive start. Is the balance right? I'd argue that Georgia Stanway and Mariona Caldentey are trying to perform the same function in midfield, both as the primary No 8. Who is dictating from deep?

Is the best use of Russo as a No 10? Should she not be on the last line of defence? Are the wingers too shy to go one-vs-one? Lisa Baum and Olivia Smith managed just one cross and one dribble between them at the weekend, albeit the delivery Baum did use to pick out Blackstenius should have resulted in a goal.

Instead of attacking Manchester United's weaknesses as they get to grips with a new style of play under Eva Olid, Arsenal spent most of the game standing off, too polite to properly engage. This squad is too talented to exercise such reserve.

Slegers needs to demand more. More refinement from the playmakers, better options and service from wide areas, sharper finishing. Everything in the final third, in fact, can go up several gears. Until that happens, disappointing draws are all Arsenal really deserve.

Someone who is not suffering with a crisis of confidence in front of goal is Tottenham's Holdt. Since the start of February, only Bunny Shaw (12) has found the net more times than her eight.

The fluidity with which Spurs attack is fresh and exciting. Crystal Palace held out for an entire half before feeling the full brunt of Martin Ho's wonderfully inventive side in a 7-0 drubbing, scoring six goals in a devastating 25-minute period.

Holdt's hat-trick set the tone. A perfect treble of differing strikes. One from a neatly worked throw routine, an instinctive banger from a loose ball inside the box and another from a high turnover.

To my eye, she is a great blend of talent meets determination and has adapted to the demands of the league quicker than most. She is a scorer and creator of goals, who can carry the ball just as well as she distributes it.

On her first Spurs start this season, she gave Ho plenty to think about as his side move up to second in the table. The challenge now is to stay there.

articles.title: El Málaga está siendo sorprendido por Primera tras un ascenso inesperado
articles.standfirst: La opinión de Antonio J. Merchán
articles.summary: La opinión de Antonio J. Merchán
articles.body: El Getafe probablemente sea uno de los peores escenarios posibles para un equipo que necesita reaccionar. Y más todavía cuando la urgencia aprieta y el partido se juega en el Coliseum. Aun así, el Málaga estuvo durante muchos minutos a la altura de las circunstancias. Compitió, tuvo el balón y durante la primera parte incluso hizo méritos para marcharse por delante. El problema volvió a aparecer después del descanso. El equipo de Bordalás sabe perfectamente cómo jugar este tipo de partidos: permite que el rival tenga el control cuando le interesa y espera su momento. Cuando el físico del Málaga comenzó a bajar, apareció la realidad de una plantilla con muy pocas soluciones desde el banquillo. Otra derrota. Otro 1-0. Y siete jornadas después, el casillero de victorias sigue a cero. Los números dicen que el Málaga es colista y que, si nada cambia, el camino de regreso a Segunda parece evidente. Pero creo que sería un error darlo por hecho. Y, sobre todo, sería injusto cargar toda la responsabilidad sobre Juanfran Funes. Porque aquí hay una historia que ya conocemos. La inversión en la plantilla ha sido escasa, la planificación deportiva volvió a dejar demasiadas incógnitas y, una vez más, parece que la responsabilidad de encontrar soluciones termina recayendo casi exclusivamente sobre el entrenador. Si las cosas salen mal, será muy sencillo señalar al que ocupa el banquillo. Mucho más complicado será mirar hacia arriba. Juan Ramón Muñiz, al que sabes que aprecio especialmente y cuya familia también me merece un enorme cariño, sufrió en su día una corriente de opinión muy injusta. También la sufrió posteriormente Sergio Pellicer. Y existe ahora el riesgo de que Juanfran Funes termine recorriendo exactamente el mismo camino. Muñiz consiguió evitar otro descenso después de aquel ascenso inesperado y dejó una base de jugadores que posteriormente demostraron su enorme valor. Pellicer fue todavía más allá. Durante mucho tiempo ejerció de escudo para el club. Aguantó críticas, decisiones y situaciones difíciles sin trasladar los problemas al exterior. Protegió a sus jugadores y, mientras tanto, hizo encaje de bolillos para devolver al Málaga al fútbol profesional. También apostó por la cantera. Dio oportunidades a futbolistas que terminaron convirtiéndose en protagonistas del fútbol español y, en algunos casos, llegando incluso a la selección. Y pese a todo ello terminó saliendo por la puerta de atrás después de una mala dinámica de resultados. Ahora puede repetirse la historia con Funes. Y sería un error. Porque basta con mirar de dónde viene el técnico de Loja. Un entrenador formado en la cantera, que llegó al filial en una situación complicada y que, con trabajo, terminó consiguiendo ascenderlo tres temporadas después. Su llegada al primer equipo no fue fruto de un capricho, sino la consecuencia de un camino recorrido dentro de la casa. Después llegó el ascenso a Primera. Otra vez el Málaga consiguió convertir una situación que parecía complicada en un éxito deportivo extraordinario. Como ocurrió en Tarragona, como ocurrió con Pellicer, el trabajo terminó imponiéndose a una realidad que sobre el papel parecía mucho más complicada. Por eso este parón debería servir para algo más que recuperar fuerzas. Debe ser una oportunidad para que quienes tienen que tomar decisiones revisen lo que no se ha hecho bien. Todavía hay margen para corregir errores, aunque algunos sean ya demasiado evidentes. Y, sobre todo, para no volver a cometer el mismo error de siempre: buscar al culpable más cercano. ¡Memoria, Compromiso y Fe!, sobre todo esto último.

articles.title: New name, new symbol, new battle: Mamata Banerjee camp unveils ‘football player’ logo
articles.summary: KOLKATA: The Mamata Banerjee-led faction of the TMC on Monday unveiled a new logo featuring its interim election symbol, a football player, and asked .
articles.body: KOLKATA: The Mamata Banerjee-led faction of the TMC on Monday unveiled a new logo featuring its interim election symbol, a football player, and asked its leaders and elected representatives to publicise it as the party seeks to build a new electoral identity after losing, for now, its familiar name and flowers-and-grass logo.The symbol features the football player at its centre, surrounded by the words 'Mamata All India Trinamool Congress' in white against a blue background.Saffron, white and green have also been incorporated into the design, news agency PTI reported.The exercise comes days after the Election Commission froze the use of the 'All India Trinamool Congress' name and its reserved flowers-and-grass logo amid an escalating internal dispute over control of the party.The poll panel subsequently allotted separate interim identities to the two groups for the October 6 bypolls.The Mamata faction was given 'Mamata All India Trinamool Congress' and the 'football player' symbol, while the rival faction led by Arup Roy was allotted 'Democratic Trinamool Congress' and the 'envelope' symbol, PTI reported.With only a fortnight left for the Nandigram and Rejinagar bypolls, the Mamata camp is seeking to ensure that voters can connect the new symbol with the political identity they have traditionally associated with the Trinamool Congress.Party sources said all office-bearers, leaders, workers and elected representatives had been asked to use their respective platforms to circulate the logo and familiarise voters with the new logo.Leaders from the Mamata camp began posting the logo on social media from Monday afternoon.On September 17, the poll panel, while hearing rival claims over the Trinamool Congress, ordered that neither faction would be permitted to use the party's existing name and symbol pending a substantive determination of the dispute.The decision came on the last day of nominations for the bypolls, prompting the EC to ask the factions to suggest alternative names and free symbols so that the electoral process could proceed,A day later, the Commission gave the two groups their temporary identities, effectively turning the party's internal battle over ownership into a contest between two different names and symbols on the ballot.For the Mamata faction, the choice of name includes 'Mamata' in its interim identity, while the football-player symbol gives the faction a new visual marker to take to the electorate.The new identities will face their first direct electoral test in Rejinagar, where the two rival Trinamool factions remain in the fray.Nandigram, however, has taken a different course.Mamata Banerjee's nominee Sanchita Pradhan Dey withdrew from the contest after meeting Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, following which Banerjee extended support to Congress candidate Milan Pradhan. Pradhan was subsequently arrested in connection with cases dating back to the 2007 Nandigram land acquisition movement.The contrasting developments mean Rejinagar will see the rival Trinamool camps carry their newly assigned names and symbols into a direct contest, while in Nandigram, the Mamata camp is out of the electoral race and has extended support to a Congress candidate.The dispute has also acquired a legal dimension, with Banerjee challenging the Commission's freeze before the Supreme Court.The apex court on Monday agreed to urgently list her plea, with the rival side also set to get an opportunity to make its submissions.That legal battle could ultimately determine what happens to the original party name and symbol. The political campaign, however, cannot wait for that resolution.The Mamata camp's immediate task is consequently to make the football player familiar enough for voters to recognise it on October 6.The new symbol seeks to bring together Mamata's name, the words Trinamool Congress and the unfamiliar football player as the faction heads into an election in which its traditional electoral identity has, at least temporarily, been put on hold.(With agency inputs)You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Kolkata | Silver Rate in Kolkata | Bank Holidays in Kolkata | Public Holidays in Kolkata | Kolkata AQI | Weather in Kolkata | Petrol Price in Kolkata | Diesel Price in Kolkata | CNG Price in Kolkata | LPG Price in KolkataStay updated with the latest Kolkata news. articles.summary: LSU women's basketball missed on a priority recruit, losing a blue-chip prospect to SEC rival Florida.
articles.body:
LSU women's basketball missed on one of the top forwards in the 2027 recruiting class. Madi Mignery committed to Florida, according to a report from Rivals' Talia Goodman on Sunday. She picked the Gators out of a top three that included LSU and Stanford.

Mignery made a trip to Baton Rouge a week before announcing her decision. She spent time head coach Kim Mulkey and staff during the weekend of LSU football's game against Louisiana Tech. The Gators visited Mignery at her home a few days before she headed to LSU.

Rivals' Industry Rankings lists Mignery as the No. 25 overall prospect in the 2027 cycle and the No. 2 player out of Florida. The six-foot small forward hails from Sarasota, FL. She ranks No. 8 at her position.

The Tigers remain in the mix for three of the top-25 prospects in the 2027 recruiting class. They hosted small forward Ivana Wilson-Manyack and combo guard GG Banks in early September. Carolina Bradley, who is already committed to LSU, also made the trip to campus. All three rank in the national top 10 among 2027 players.

articles.title: El Sabadell sigue en modo 'David contra Goliat'
articles.standfirst: El equipo arlequinado es sexto en su regreso a LaLiga Hypermotion
articles.summary: El equipo arlequinado es sexto en su regreso a LaLiga Hypermotion
articles.body: El Sabadell ha regresado al fútbol profesional tras un doble ascenso histórico y, por ende, a los cromos y a los videojuegos, pero ni el aficionado más optimista podía prever un inicio de curso tan feliz e ilusionante, tan extraordinario. El equipo de Ferran Costa sigue en modo David contra Goliat y ha cerrado la sexta jornada en la sexta posición después de su brillante y merecida victoria contra el Oviedo (3-1), la tercera en tres partidos en el fortín de la Nova Creu Alta. El Sabadell tiene la plantilla menos valiosa de toda la categoría con apenas 10,6 millones de euros según el portal especializado Transfermarkt, pero sigue desafiando toda lógica. Ya ganó al Almería, segundo en esa clasificación con 60 millones, solo por detrás del Girona, y este domingo sometió al Oviedo, cuarto con 35. Su única derrota ha llegado en casa del Mallorca (50). El equipo arlequinado tiene un valor medio por jugador que no llega a los 400.000 euros y, de hecho, solo tiene un nombre por encima de los 0,8 millones: Patrick Nuamah (1,6), un joven italiano de 20 años que ni siquiera ha debutado. La plantilla está llena de recién llegados a Segunda que han sabido anteponer la falta de experiencia a la ilusión, al hambre y a las ganas de aprovechar la oportunidad que llevaban persiguiendo toda una vida. "Llevo toda la vida peleando por una oportunidad en el fútbol profesional y ahora no la voy a dejar escapar", dijo Alain Ribeiro en su puesta de largo. "Somos un equipo de obreros", aseguró Óscar Sanz, uno de los goleadores contra el Oviedo. En la plantilla incluso hay cinco héroes del doble ascenso consecutivo que ha devuelto al Sabadell a Segunda. "Jugadores por los que la gente no daba un duro en esta categoría", según reivindicó Costa después de la brillante victoria contra el Oviedo. El Sabadell volvió a superar a su adversario a base de hambre e intensidad con una puesta en escena maravillosa y ya tiene 11 puntos de 18 posibles, a pesar de haber abierto el curso con un calendario muy exigente, un auténtico Tourmalet. Ya se ha enfrentado a tres de los cuatro equipos más caros de Segunda. A dos equipos que vienen de Primera y dos que vienen de jugar el playoff, más el noveno clasificado del curso pasado (Córdoba) y el noveno del presente (Sporting). Es el único equipo que ha conseguido puntuar contra el Castellón, el líder intratable. Incluso hizo méritos para ganar en Castalia. Su secreto es el hambre y la identidad, el sentimiento de pertenencia de un bloque unido: "Cantamos el himno en el vestuario antes de cada partido y también en el autocar. Es la canción con la que llegamos a los estadios cuando jugamos fuera de casa", añadió Costa, el director del bus. Sueña en grande como cualquier arlequinado, pero impone prudencia cada vez que habla: "La competición siempre va adelante y no nos podemos quedar atrás. No es momento de sacar pecho ni de historias de estas". Pero si el equipo sigue así será difícil contener la euforia. Ya son ocho puntos de ventaja sobre el descenso y el objetivo de la permanencia pronto puede quedarse pequeño.

articles.title: Uruguay window in doubt as Fede Valverde awaits ankle tests
articles.summary: Real Madrid issued an official medical update on Fede Valverde on September 20, confirming severe trauma to the midfielder’s left ankle following the derby d...
articles.body:
Real Madrid issued an official medical update on Fede Valverde on September 20, confirming severe trauma to the midfielder's left ankle following the derby defeat to Atletico Madrid . The Uruguay an finished the match despite the knock, meaning the immediate picture is one of uncertainty rather than a confirmed spell on the sidelines.

Valverde picked up the injury during the 2-1 loss at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano, a result that continued a difficult run for Los Blancos following their win over Inter Milan . According to the primary club report, the damage stemmed from a strong tackle by Atletico's Kang-in Lee that went unpunished by referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias. Despite the challenge, Valverde stayed on the pitch and played out the remainder of the derby.

In a statement carried on the club's official website, Real Madrid said tests carried out by its medical services on the day of the match diagnosed Valverde with severe trauma to his left ankle, sustained during the derby. The club added that the midfielder would undergo further tests in the coming hours to establish the full extent of the problem.

No timetable for a return has been given, and Real Madrid have not specified whether the injury amounts to a sprain, a more serious ligament issue, or simple bruising that will clear quickly. That distinction is expected to become clearer once the additional examinations are completed, though the club has offered nothing further beyond the initial diagnosis at this stage.

The most concrete implication in Real Madrid's own reporting concerns Valverde's international commitments rather than his club fixtures. Should the follow-up tests confirm an ankle sprain, he could miss Uruguay's upcoming FIFA international window entirely, a scenario the club has flagged as a possibility rather than a certainty.

For now, that remains conditional on the results still to come. Real Madrid's squad has already had to navigate absences of various kinds in recent weeks, a theme covered in Football España's look at the club's selection options around the Inter fixture , and Jose Mourinho may again find himself managing without a key midfield presence depending on what the coming hours reveal about Valverde's ankle.

articles.title: Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate
articles.summary: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka is being investigated over an issue with his Covid-19 vaccination certificate.
articles.body:
Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka is under investigation by Swiss prosecutors over allegations he obtained a forged Covid-19 vaccination certificate.

The 33-year-old is alleged to have obtained the certificate in 2022, when it was a requirement in Switzerland for some travel abroad.

The public prosecutor's office of the city of Lucerne confirmed the investigation was under way to determine whether any criminal behaviour took place in obtaining a "false or forged" certificate.

The Sunderland midfielder, who was playing for Arsenal at the time, posted a statement on social media on Monday saying he had a "mistrust" towards the vaccine and had been "influenced by worries and uncertainty".

He said: "In this troubled state of mind I acquired a vaccine certificate, instead of clarifying my unanswered questions in the proper way.

"Today I see clearly, that this way was not correct. It was a mistake. I'm sorry.

"I take responsibility for this decision, will engage with the process of establishing the facts and fully co-operate with the relevant authorities."

The Swiss office of public health confirmed that while there was never a general legal requirement to obtain or hold such a certificate, it was needed for access to various activities, venues and travel, meaning that participation was restricted for anyone who did not possess one.

These measures in Switzerland were in place until spring 2022. After that point, Covid-19 certificates continued to be issued, primarily to enable members of the public to meet entry requirements when travelling abroad.

The Swiss Football Association said Xhaka, the country's record appearance holder with 152 caps, had withdrawn from the Swiss camp for their upcoming Nations League matches against Scotland , North Macedonia and Slovenia following his statement.

It added the decision to withdraw had been made jointly by the player and management and that they would discuss Xhaka's future with the team after the international window.

Switzerland have away fixtures against North Macedonia and Scotland on 26 and 29 September, before facing Slovenia and North Macedonia at home in early October.

Sunderland boss Regis le Bris refused to comment on the allegations following the Black Cats' defeat at Manchester City on Sunday.

"It is not my area to speak about those problems or situations," he said. "My area is football. About football, he is really good."

Xhaka captained Switzerland at the World Cup earlier this year, where they were knocked out in the quarter-finals by eventual runners-up Argentina .
